# Butterneck

> Let them ask. You decide what goes live.

Butterneck is for product teams. People ask on a live copy of the product. The AI edits the project on a computer the team connects. A developer decides what goes live.

- Home: https://butterneck.com/
- Privacy: https://butterneck.com/privacy
- Terms: https://butterneck.com/terms
- Contact: https://butterneck.com/contact
- Jira privacy: https://butterneck.com/jira/privacy
- Jira terms: https://butterneck.com/jira/terms

The product app (signup, login, workspaces) is at https://app.butterneck.com.
